dedupeText: 3d urban vinyl toy aesthetic vinyl toy urban cgi barbed wire 3d character streetwear aesthetic chrome texture character centered in the foreground barbed wire weaving through the z axis high gloss metallic textures against matte skin vibrant accent colors neon green against dark clothing 3d vinyl toy chrome barbed wire urban streetwear aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: Generates stylized 3D characters with smooth vinyl-like skin, oversized jewelry, and metallic barbed wire elements in a high-contrast urban setting.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central 3D stylized character with smooth, dark-toned skin and exaggerated features, adorned with heavy silver chains and a custom pendant, framed by glowing or metallic barbed wire loops against a cluttered urban background.
coreVisualRelationships: Barbed wire weaving through the Z-axis
High-gloss metallic textures against matte skin
Vibrant accent colors (neon green) against dark clothing
coreInvariants: Circular or spiraling barbed wire framing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central figure occupying the middle 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The character's face and the large silver pendant held in the hand.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion following the barbed wire from the bottom text up around the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with background details and foreground wire.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and black for background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright neon green for clothing patterns and accents.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: High-shine silver/chrome for jewelry and wire.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in accents with high value contrast between chrome and dark shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are constructed entirely from twisted metallic barbed wire
Sharp, protruding spikes at every joint
characterSpecificRedesigns: Wire loops form the counters of letters

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the base of the composition

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant illustrative style for all text elements.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the physical integration of the text into the scene

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D urban scene with a vinyl-toy style character wearing neon green and black streetwear, surrounded by floating chrome barbed wire loops.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large display text at the bottom rendered as 3D chrome barbed wire, ensuring the spikes and twists match the environmental wire.

verificationChecks: Is the skin texture smooth and vinyl-like?
Does the text appear to be made of physical barbed wire?
Are the neon green accents vibrant against the dark background?
Is the jewelry rendered with high-gloss chrome reflections?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (e.g., neon green to hot pink)
postGenerationChecks: Verify barbed wire does not obscure the character's face
Ensure text is legible despite the wire texture
Confirm the 'vinyl toy' material look is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: 3D Vinyl Toy + Chrome Barbed Wire + Urban Streetwear Aesthetic
